subject: Private deployment: evidence routing & operator access — MSA + Order Form
messages:
From: Emily Smith <emily.smith@brightlinehealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@brightlinehealth.com
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: MSA + VPC addendum: evidence routing & operator access questions

Neha —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Attached is our current MSA draft (Brightline_MSA_draft_v2.docx) and a short PDF with inline comments on the VPC addendum. Legal has three asks we need clarified before we can present this to Procurement: 

1) Evidence bundle: they expect an itemized list of what Redwood will provide for a private VPC deployment (operator runbook, snapshot/export procedure, temporary witnessing window, test access). Please call out delivery format (encrypted archive, signed manifest), retention period, and whether snapshots include keys or just encrypted blobs.

2) Audit access & windows: our auditors need a 4-hour witness window and a process for temporary access (SAML time-limited accounts or jumpbox). We also need the escalation path if an operator must access customer VMs for troubleshooting.

3) Contract language: they flagged a clause about "custody and control" that looks broader than we expected — Brightline wants confirmation that operator access is scoped and that Redwood will provide a documented rollback procedure and chain-of-custody for any snapshot handover.

Can you share Redwood's proposed exhibit or playbook for this? We have a tentative internal deadline to finalize the MSA redlines by Fri 6 Aug so Procurement can issue the PO. Happy to set a short call to walk through items.

Thanks —
Emily Smith
Director, Procurement & Contracts
Brightline Health

Attachments: Brightline_MSA_draft_v2.docx (docx), Brightline_VPC_Addendum_comments.pdf (pdf)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: MSA + VPC addendum: evidence routing & operator access questions

Team — forwarding Brightline's asks. Quick summary and proposed approach: 

- Evidence bundle: we should propose a single TAR.GZ (encrypted) plus a signed manifest and a short acceptance checklist. Include: runbook (PDF), snapshot export procedure (step-by-step), sample snapshot metadata (hashes), and a forensic checklist for handover. Recommend retention: 90 days for the working snapshot, 365 days for manifests/metadata.

- Keys: we cannot hand over plaintext private keys. Offer a sealed snapshot (encrypted with customer-managed KMS) and an attestation report from our SR team confirming the snapshot was taken and the VM state captured. If customer insists on key handback, escalate to Legal — that's an exception and requires additional indemnity.

- Audit windows & temporary access: propose a SAML time-limited role + SSH bastion with strict SCIM deprovisioning; provide a 4-hour witness window by default. Add an operator checklist and point people for escalation (first-tier: Support/AWS; second-tier: Neha (sales legal liaison) + David (security lead)).

- Rollback/chain-of-custody: create a new exhibit in the Order Form called "Exhibit: Evidence & Operational Handover" with: handover steps, witness signoff template, and sample manifest. That exhibit will reference the MSA's operator access carveouts.

Can David draft the short exhibit template and a sample manifest? Lauren — can you confirm whether Finance needs this called out on the order form or can it be an attached exhibit only? I want to keep the Order Form concise.

I think we should propose a Tues 3 Aug 30-min sync with Brightline legal to walk through. Emily, are you available?

-Neha
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: MSA + VPC addendum: evidence routing & operator access questions

Neha / Lauren —

Thanks — I attached a first-pass "Exhibit: Evidence & Operational Handover" (Redwood_redlines_marked.docx) that we can slot into the Order Form as an exhibit. High-level notes: 

- Snapshot content: we will provide a compressed, encrypted VM snapshot + metadata manifest (SHA256 checksums, UTC timestamps, image id). We will not provide private key material. If the customer needs ciphertext decrypted, that requires an explicit legal carveout and additional SOW / escrow-like mechanism.

- Witnessing and temporary access: propose two options: 
  a) Witness-lite: customer observes snapshot creation via screen-sharing + signed manifest; 4-hour observation window for forensics team.
  b) Witnessed handover: a sealed copy is transferred via customer KMS wrap and a custodial manifest is signed by both parties; operator access limited to scoped troubleshooting only and requires pre-approved Jira ticket and time-bound session.

- Chain-of-custody: include a short template with signer names, timestamp, artifact hash, and transfer method. If Brightline requires an escrow deposit of images, we should mark this as "optional add-on" and route to Sales Ops for pricing.

- Timeline: to meet Brightline's 6 Aug internal redline deadline, we need to get Legal review + a 30-min sync by Tues 3 Aug. I'll attach the redline and a sample manifest.

Next steps: 
- Neha: confirm sync time with Brightline (Tues 3 Aug preferred)
- Lauren: confirm whether Finance requires the exhibit to appear on the face of the Order Form or as an attached exhibit
- David: will prepare final exhibit + two short variation templates (witness-lite, witnessed handover) by Mon 2 Aug EOD

-David
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: Redwood_redlines_marked.docx (redline), sample_manifest_example.json (metadata example)

Neha —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and David's redline — this is helpful. Brightline is comfortable with the "witness-lite" path for the initial PO but would like the alternate (witnessed handover) language preserved in the exhibit in case we need a deeper forensic transfer later (we will not request it today).

We are available for a 30-min sync Tues 3 Aug at 10:00 AM PT. Please send a calendar invite and the latest exhibit draft ahead of the call.

Also, one small procurement ask: can you call out whether the exhibit changes have any subscription price or one-time professional services fee? If you can give a placeholder estimate for the optional escrow-like witnessed handover (ballpark), Procurement can provision approval while legal keeps the language optional.

Thanks —
Emily Smith

Brightline Health
